title: Same-pass Qwen3.5 feature taps plus explicit multimodal recovery boundary
finding: Qwen3.5 Transformers exposes pre- and post-merger visual features from one visual pass; libmtmd publicly exposes encoded media embeddings for decode reuse but its serialized chunks are metadata-only, and current llama-server failure evidence prevents assuming durable multimodal slot/KV recovery.
frank_relevance: Enables a lower-cost falsifiable MVC feature-tap comparison while forcing provenance/recovery to remain independent of ephemeral VLM cache state.
unresolved_uncertainty: Exact target-VPS Qwen3.5 feature geometry, libmtmd pre-merger accessibility and multimodal restart behavior remain unmeasured.
